Package com.esignal.jstandard.beans.news

Purpose of this package is to host all request and response beans related to News.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    NewsRequest
    Purpose of this class is to hold request parameters before giving it to News server.
    StoryRequest
    Purpose of this class is to hold request parameters before giving it to News server for requesting a story.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    DefaultNewsRequest
    DefaultNewsRequest is a default implementation of the NewsRequest interface.
    DefaultStoryRequest
    DefaultStoryRequest is a default implementation of the StoryRequest interface.
    Headline
    This class is used to send the Headline information back to the client using the HeadlineEvent using the NewsListener or NewsRequestListener Interfaces.
    Story
    This class is used to send the story body and story type information back to the client using the StoryEvent using the NewsRequestListener Interfaces onResponse() method.
  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    NewsRequest.NEWS_ACTION
    This enum is used by the response Headline object to specify the News Headline Action.
    NewsRequest.NEWS_SEARCH_FIELDS
    This enum is used to specify the fields to be used for the search criteria.
    NewsRequest.NEWS_SORT_ORDER
    This enum is used to set the sort orer for returning the News Headlines.
    StoryRequest.NEWS_STORY_FORMAT
    This enum is used to specify the format in which the client desires the News Story to be returned.
